verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own Auto-Sync feature automatically commits, pulls and pushes whenever changes are detected, with optional Background Sync. That is a built-in event-triggered action, but it is a single fixed behavior rather than user-defined rules. Shortcuts and x-callback-url integration is host-platform or building-block plumbing, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: user-definable rule/trigger configuration, a choice of event types and actions, conditional logic, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: _Auto-Sync_ does all of this for you, committing, pulling and pushing whenever changes are detected.
Turn on _Background Sync_ to keep syncing while you use other apps
